newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ICI Australia says M.D. Haynes dies.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ICI Australia says M.D. Haynes dies.

text.p: Chemicals group ICI Australia Ltd said on Tuesday that its managing director Warren Haynes died after a short illness.

In a statement to ICI Australia's employees, chairman Dr Ben Lochtenberg said: "It is with the deepest personal sadness that I must advise that our managing director, Warren Haynes, died today after a very short illness."
"Words are inadequate to express our grief at losing such a marvellous leader, colleague and most importantly, friend," Lochtenberg said.
"The heartfelt sympathy of everyone a ICI Australia goes out to his wife, Barbara, his daughters, Cathy and Jennifer, and his mother, Ms Thelma Haynes, at this time," he said.
Lochtenberg said the board will meet shortly to consider the position of chief executive. In the meantime Lochtenberg will act as chief executive.
ICI Australia's major shareholder, Imperial Chemical Industries Plc, plans to sell its 62.4 percent stake in the Australia group.
Last month, ICI Australia said it planned to buy back A$360 million of its own shares from ICI Plc.
At 12.40 p.m. (0240 GMT), ICI Australia shares were five cents down at A$12.00.
